origin_valid.name: origin_valid
origin_valid.value: "fulfillment_origins"."status" IN ('active','inactive') AND (NOT "fulfillment_origins"."is_default" OR "fulfillment_origins"."status" = 'active') AND "fulfillment_origins"."country_code" = 'ID' AND ("fulfillment_origins"."latitude" IS NULL OR "fulfillment_origins"."latitude"::numeric BETWEEN -90 AND 90) AND ("fulfillment_origins"."longitude" IS NULL OR "fulfillment_origins"."longitude"::numeric BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

overhead_cost_valid.name: overhead_cost_valid
overhead_cost_valid.value: "global_overhead_costs"."amount_rupiah" >= 0 AND ("global_overhead_costs"."end_date" IS NULL OR "global_overhead_costs"."end_date" >= "global_overhead_costs"."start_date") AND "global_overhead_costs"."category" IN ('INFRASTRUCTURE','SOFTWARE','FACILITY','ADMINISTRATION','MARKETING','OTHER') AND "global_overhead_costs"."billing_frequency" IN ('MONTHLY','ANNUAL','ONE_TIME') AND "global_overhead_costs"."recognition_method" IN ('SPREAD_MONTHLY','CHARGE_IN_BILLING_PERIOD')

overhead_period_valid.name: overhead_period_valid
overhead_period_valid.value: extract(day from "global_overhead_periods"."period_month") = 1 AND "global_overhead_periods"."forecast_units_remaining" > 0 AND "global_overhead_periods"."opening_carry_forward_rupiah" >= 0 AND (("global_overhead_periods"."status" = 'OPEN' AND "global_overhead_periods"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "global_overhead_periods"."closing_unrecovered_rupiah" IS NULL) OR ("global_overhead_periods"."status" = 'CLOSED' AND "global_overhead_periods"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "global_overhead_periods"."closing_unrecovered_rupiah" >= 0))

pricing_profile_valid.name: pricing_profile_valid
pricing_profile_valid.value: "product_pricing_profiles"."profit_bps" >= 0 AND "product_pricing_profiles"."tax_bps" >= 0 AND "product_pricing_profiles"."tax_bps" < 10000 AND "product_pricing_profiles"."rounding_rupiah" IN (1,1000,5000,10000) AND ("product_pricing_profiles"."method" = 'MARKUP' OR ("product_pricing_profiles"."method" = 'TARGET_MARGIN' AND "product_pricing_profiles"."profit_bps" + "product_pricing_profiles"."tax_bps" < 10000))
